AMD Ryzen 5 5500GT 6-Core 12-Thread Desktop Processor with Radeon Graphics


Build a high-performance, budget-friendly desktop system with the AMD Ryzen 5 5500GT desktop processor. Built on the proven and highly reliable AM4 architecture, this versatile 6-core, 12-thread CPU delivers impressive multi-threaded processing power, making it an exceptional choice for smooth everyday multitasking, home office productivity, student workloads, and casual content creation without breaking the bank.


The standout feature of the Ryzen 5 5500GT is its integrated AMD Radeon Graphics, which eliminates the immediate need for a dedicated graphics card. It delivers fluid, high-definition visual performance and solid frame rates in popular esports titles and mainstream casual games. With a base clock speed engineered for efficiency and a boost clock designed for heavy lifting under demand, this heavy-duty processor keeps your system running cool and snappy. Upgrade your PC with legendary AMD performance and enjoy a seamless computing and gaming experience right out of the box.


AMD Ryzen 5 5500GT processor:

​Core Specifications

  • ​Total Cores: 6
  • ​Total Threads: 12
  • ​Base Clock: 3.6 GHz
  • ​Max Boost Clock: Up to 4.4 GHz
  • ​Architecture: Zen 3 (Cezanne)
  • ​Process Technology: TSMC 7nm FinFET
  • ​Default TDP: 65W
  • ​Unlocked for Overclocking: Yes

​Cache

  • ​L1 Cache: 384 KB
  • ​L2 Cache: 3 MB
  • ​L3 Cache: 16 MB

​Memory Specifications

  • ​System Memory Type: DDR4
  • ​Max Memory Speed: Up to 3200 MT/s
  • ​Memory Channels: 2

​Connectivity & Graphics

  • ​Integrated Graphics: AMD Radeon™ Graphics (7 Cores)
  • ​Graphics Frequency: 1900 MHz
  • ​PCI Express Version: PCIe 3.0
  • ​Socket: AM4

​Thermal Information

  • ​Max Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 95°C
  • ​Thermal Solution: AMD Wraith Stealth included
